'''Kohlbacca''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Albino/Legends|albino]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]]. She served as first mate aboard the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Daring (transport)|''Daring'']] during the [[Confederation Rock Rush]], the exploration of the [[Cularin asteroid belt]]. She was knocked out when the ''Daring'' collided with an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] and was severely damaged. She was nicknamed "Frost" because of her white-[[Color/Legends|colored]] fur.
